title: A conversation with Vercel's Guillermo Rauch
description:
Guillermo Rauch, CEO and founder of Vercel, joins Stripe's Head of Data & AI, Emily Glassberg Sands, for a fireside chat on how Vercel scaled to $200 million ARR by shipping week-over-week, why AI agents are becoming the next users of software, and how natural language is transforming into the new programming primitive for builders.

Learn more at https://stripe.com/startups
fulltitle: A conversation with Vercel's Guillermo Rauch
